parameters.name: BackupPlanId
parameters.description: The ID of the backup plan. To get this ID, call the [DescribeBackupPlanList](~~2869825~~) operation.

parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description: A client token to ensure the idempotence of the request.

parameters.name: DisableMysqlPhysicalBackupBinlogOnly
parameters.description: Specifies whether to disable only the log backup feature for a physical backup of a MySQL database.
